author: Lulonaro2000
quote: Simply perfect, it serves as an example for the entire industry on how to make a game, and a remake. Oh, how this passion for game development is missing in the West.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Lulonaro2000
quote: Although the game is wonderful in terms of worldbuilding, it falls quite short as a "GTA-style" experience, the story is very restrictive and features disappointing conclusions. You can still have a lot of fun, though, if you play it as if it were a "goat simulator." For me, it got tiresome after 15 hours.
